protectionchange.midnightconfig.title: Main Config
protectionchange.midnightconfig.formulaT: Type of formula to use. CUSTOM isn't currently implemented
protectionchange.midnightconfig.maxProtL:
Maximum level of protection across all armor.
Can be calculated by multiplying the maximum level of protection obtainable by 4; vanilla is 20, as protection only goes up to 4.
Used across all formulas.
protectionchange.midnightconfig.sqrtCons:
Constant to use for the SQUARE_ROOT formula.
Must be between 0 and 1.
Only used for the SQUARE_ROOT formula.
protectionchange.midnightconfig.rootExpo:
The exponent to use for the root.
Must be between 0 and 1.
Only change if you know what you're doing; leave at 0.5 for square root
protectionchange.midnightconfig.linearRa:
The rate at which each level of protection increases its damage reduction, as a percentage per level.
A rate of 0.04 replicates vanilla's formula, as this is effectively how vanilla does it.
Only used for the LINEAR formula.
